checks.listener_lifetime: met. The listener is attached right after pool.connect() resolves. No socket event can come between the pool's checkout (pg-pool removes its idle listener there, node_modules/pg-pool/index.js:344) and the attach, because a promise continuation runs before any I/O callback. A client returned to the pool loses the listener after release(false), and the pool's idle listener takes over. A client released as broken keeps it, so a late socket event cannot end the process. Probe: normal path → release(false) and 0 own listeners; a late error on a dropped client → no uncaught error.
checks.dropped_client_released_as_broken: met. After the event every statement throws E_DB_DOWN without being sent (pg.js:81). COMMIT is never sent on a broken client, and release(drop || broken) drops it. Probes: a drop during an in-flight statement, a drop between statements and a drop after fn's last statement each give E_DB_DOWN, no COMMIT, a ROLLBACK attempt and release(true).
checks.no_error_swallowed: met. The listener only sets a flag. The failure surfaces through the next statement or the in-flight one (rejected by the driver) as DbError E_DB_DOWN, the existing 503 path. A throw of fn passes on as the same object. Through the app, a dropped connection answers 503 {"error":"db_unavailable"} and the next request answers 200 with no uncaught error.
checks.no_secret_or_message_logged: met. The listener logs nothing. The DbError carries its fixed text ('the database does not answer'), never the driver's message, whose planted host and address do not appear. The app's log line holds route, status and code db_unavailable only.
checks.unchanged_paths: met. Normal: begin, statements, commit, release to the pool. Rollback on a throw: not awaited, then release(true) as before. The plain query and exec paths and connectPgSession are untouched (pool.query keeps pg-pool's own once('error') listener, pg-pool index.js:464).

items.Q7: met (no message text or secret reaches a log line, an answer or an error).
items.Q9: unchanged (no statement text added except the existing begin, commit and rollback).
items.Q10: met. This is the fix itself: a dropped connection is a 503 for that request, the process lives and serves the next one. The control run on bddef13 records the uncaught 'Connection terminated unexpectedly' error that the fix removes.
